response.text: {"title": "Our understanding of the Trust's needs", "text": "Proposals must be sent by e-mail to the Trust's office by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12, as one document of no more than 15 pages [REQ-0001]. The system must keep all personal data in the United Kingdom [REQ-0007] and be live by 2027-06-30 [REQ-0011]. It shall hold a record for each donor with their contact details and the history of their gifts [REQ-0002], and record each donor's consent to be contacted by e-mail, by post and by telephone, with the date the consent was given [REQ-0003]. For volunteers, the system shall record the hours each volunteer gives to each club [REQ-0004] and send each volunteer a reminder two days before every session they are booked on [REQ-0005]. The system should import the Trust's existing donor spreadsheet without manual retyping [REQ-0006]. The system shall be available 99% of the time in each calendar month [REQ-0009], the supplier shall train the Trust's staff before the system goes live [REQ-0010], and bidders may offer a mobile app for volunteers as an optional extra [REQ-0008].", "cited_ids": ["REQ-0001", "REQ-0007", "REQ-0011", "REQ-0002", "REQ-0003", "REQ-0004", "REQ-0005", "REQ-0006", "REQ-0009", "REQ-0010", "REQ-0008"]}
